title: Support Copilot
summary: An agent-assist copilot that cut handle time 31% across 1,200 support agents.
brief: Problem: agents spent 40% of each ticket searching docs.
Bet: grounded answers inside the reply box, never auto-send.
Role: led PM for a team of 9 across ML, eng and design.
Result: −31% handle time, CSAT flat-to-up, 92% weekly usage.
Lesson: evaluation design mattered more than model choice.
